narr: Deep monsoon moisture and light steering winds brought heavy rain and flash flooding to a few locations across northern Arizona.
ev: Flooding was reported along North Copeland Lane and nearby homes. Large rocks and debris covered the road and residential yards. Flash flooding was also reported in the Wupatki Trails neighborhood. The flooding was at least 100 feet wide with 2-3 foot debris in the flow.
lsr: FLOODING ALONG N COPELAND LANE AND NEARBY HOMES. LARGE BOULDERS AND DEBRIS ON ROAD AND RESIDENTIAL AREAS.
FLOODING IN WUPATKI TRAILS. REPORT OF 100 FOOT WIDE FLOW WITH 2-3 FOOT DIAMETER DEBRIS.
